name: silverbullet-search
title: SilverBullet Search
description: Search the pages of a SilverBullet wiki space, and send quick notes to it
author: kerim

commands.name: search-wiki
commands.title: Search Wiki
commands.description: Search page titles and text in your SilverBullet wiki

commands.name: send-to-duet
commands.title: Send to Duet
commands.description: Save a typed note as a new quick-note page in your SilverBullet space

preferences.name: spaceUrl
preferences.title: Space URL
preferences.description: Address of the SilverBullet space, including the space path

preferences.name: token
preferences.title: API Token
preferences.description: A SilverBullet API token for this space. Searching only needs read access; Send to Duet needs write access

preferences.name: maxResults
preferences.title: Max Results
preferences.description: Maximum number of results to show
